transcript.text:
Thank you all for the updates. Let me summarize where we stand and what's still needed before I can make the binding disposition.

From Priya (Quality Assurance): PMI testing confirms C1 and C2 are grade 304, and C3 and C4 are grade 316. However, those results are not yet formally documented — they're still in the instrument's export queue. Per S3, material release requires an identity check, and that needs to be documented. So we need Priya to get those PMI results exported and formally recorded before I can proceed.

From Luis (Production Control): The schedule calls for 600 kg of grade 304 to Job Alpha (Thursday) and 600 kg of grade 316 to Job Beta (Monday). That maps cleanly — C1 and C2 (304) to Job Alpha, C3 and C4 (316) to Job Beta. But Luis, the schedule revision hasn't been entered in the receiving disposition system yet, so the documented job assignments aren't visible. S3 requires a documented job assignment, so we need that entry completed.

From Nadia (EHS): Processing the grade 316 coils (C3 and C4) requires a dedicated chromium-bearing-metal dust collector and a 1.5-meter exclusion boundary around the cutting station. The finding is recorded, but the temporary-control notice hasn't been posted yet. That notice needs to be posted before C3 and C4 can be safely released for processing.

So here's what I need before I can issue the binding disposition:
1. Priya — please export and formally document the PMI results for all four coils so the identity check is on record.
2. Luis — please get the schedule revision entered into the receiving disposition system so the job assignments are documented.
3. Nadia — please post the temporary-control notice for the chromium-bearing-metal dust collector and 1.5-meter exclusion boundary so the EHS controls are in place for C3 and C4.

Once those three items are complete, I'll make the binding disposition: C1 and C2 to Job Alpha, C3 and C4 to Job Beta, with the EHS controls applied to the 316 coils. Please let me know as each item is wrapped up.
transcript.speaker: A1
